extensionDescription.message: Translate webpages with ChatGPT, OpenAI API, or Claude API. Restore original text anytime.

siteAccessNote.message: Choose access for this site only, or all websites, to use page, block, and selected-text translation.

sidebarNote.message:
Read in your language.
Return to the original anytime.

settingsIntro.message: Choose the language and style that make reading feel natural.

translationSettingsNote.message: Choose your preferred language and model.

concurrencyNote.message: 1–64 requests, 16 by default. All tabs share this limit. Changes apply when a new translation starts.

instructionsNote.message: Set the tone and style of your translations.

instructionsPlaceholder.message: Use a natural, polite tone. Keep product names and code identifiers unchanged, and do not summarize.

shortcutsNote.message: Click a shortcut button, then press your preferred keys. Site access must be allowed to use translation and shortcuts.

holdBlockNote.message: Hold the keys and click a block to translate or restore it.

cancelSelectionNote.message: Exit block selection and hide the highlight.

shortcutTestPlaceholder.message: Click here and press a key combination.

osShortcutNote.message: Key combinations reserved by your operating system may not be detected.

siteAccessHelp.message: Allow access to a website before using translation and shortcuts there.

excludedSitesHelp.message: Enter one domain name per line.

privacyNote.message: Translation text goes to your selected OpenAI or Anthropic connection, or the browser’s built-in API. Subscription and API connections use their respective usage allowances. The browser controls processing for built-in APIs. Original text can still be restored after disconnecting.

dataHelp.message: Exports exclude account credentials. Clearing the cache keeps the data needed to restore original text.

finishSignIn.message: Complete sign-in in the opened tab

retriesNote.message: 0–10 retries per request; default 4 (up to 5 attempts). Retries format, stream, network, timeout and server errors. Applies to new translations.

retriesInvalid.message: Retries must be a whole number between 0 and 10.

translationTimeout.message: The translation request timed out. Please try again.

developerModeInvalid.message: Developer mode must be enabled or disabled.

developerModeNote.message: Records translation inputs, instructions, responses, and errors locally. May contain private page text. Authentication tokens and API keys are excluded. Keeps recent entries up to your entry limit and the remaining default local storage quota; older entries are removed. Turning this off stops recording; Clear logs deletes the history.

sidePanelUnavailable.message: This browser cannot open the log side panel.

logsPrivacy.message: Includes original text and instructions. Stored only in this browser; authentication tokens are excluded.

logStorageError.message: Logs are visible in memory, but could not be saved locally.

maxLogEntriesNote.message: 1–1,000,000 entries; default 4,000. Older logs are removed when the entry limit or available default local storage quota, shared with settings and credentials, is reached. Lowering the limit applies immediately.

maxLogEntriesInvalid.message: Maximum log entries must be a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000.

apiKeySaved.message: API key saved on this device

subscriptionConnectionNote.message: Translations use your connected ChatGPT subscription allowance.

chromeAINote.message: Use your browser’s on-device AI without an account or API key. Prepare the model here, then close this tab once background readiness is confirmed. The browser manages model downloads and where processing takes place. Depending on your PC specifications, it may be very slow and unstable.

chromeAILanguages.message: Language support depends on your browser’s model. Choose a supported target language; unsupported source languages cannot be translated.

chromeAIContext.message: This block exceeds the local model’s context limit. Select a shorter passage.

chromeAISetupRequired.message: Open the model tab and prepare the browser model to translate.

chromeAIUnavailable.message: A compatible built-in Prompt API is not available in this browser or on this device.

chromeAIFailed.message: The local model could not complete this translation. Check the local model tab.

chromeAIPreparing.message: Preparing the local model… The first download may take several minutes.

chromeAIExecutionNote.message: Processes one block at a time. New model downloads may require another preparation click. There is no automatic switch to a cloud provider.

translatorNote.message: Translate with your browser without an account or API key. Prepare the language packs here, then close this tab once background readiness is confirmed. The browser manages language packs and where processing takes place.

translatorLanguages.message: Language pairs depend on your browser. The original language is detected automatically.

translatorSetupRequired.message: Open the browser translator tab and prepare the displayed language pack, then retry translation. A new language pair may need another download.

translatorUnavailable.message: Translator API is unavailable in this browser or its current configuration.

translatorFailed.message: Browser translation failed. Open the translator tab to prepare it again.

translatorContext.message: This text exceeds the browser translator’s input limit.

translatorSourceUnknown.message: The original language could not be detected for this text.

translatorExecutionNote.message: Processes one block at a time without custom instructions. Missing language packs open a preparation tab. Prepare the pack, then retry translation.

nativeBackgroundReady.message: Ready. You can close this tab; translation will continue in the background.

nativeTabRequired.message: Ready in this tab. Background execution is unavailable in this browser; keep this tab open.

translatorPairNote.message: Choose a pair to prepare its language pack. Page translation still detects the source automatically and uses the target in Settings.

translatorPairUnavailable.message: This language pair is not supported by your browser.

translatorPairAvailable.message: This language pack is already downloaded.

translatorPairDownload.message: This language pack needs to be downloaded.

nativeBackgroundChecking.message: Checking background execution. Keep this tab open until ready.

sourceLanguageNote.message: Applies to this page until it reloads. Auto detects each block.

languagePacksNote.message: Language pairs prepared with this extension. The browser manages downloads. Removing a pair from this list does not delete its downloaded files; the browser does not provide an uninstall API.

languagePacksEmpty.message: No language pairs have been prepared with this extension yet.

experimentalFeaturesNote.message: Optional features that are still being tested. Enable this section, then choose the features you want to use.

onDeviceAIWarning.message: Depending on your PC specifications, On-device AI may be very slow and unstable. Availability and reliability vary by browser and device. This option appears as a connection method only when your browser supports it.

experimentalSettingInvalid.message: Experimental feature settings must be on or off.

chromeAIExperimentalRequired.message: Enable Experimental features and On-device AI at the bottom of Settings to use this feature.
